subject: Leadership hiring: knife-edge decision log
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Leadership hiring: knife-edge decision log

Team — attaching the consolidated slate and a short decision matrix (2026-11-hiring-slate.xlsx). I pulled this together after the OKR check-ins this morning. TL;DR: we have three "knife-edge" requests that need leadership callouts before Friday EOD (11/20) if we want offers to land before year-end.

Critical items: 
- Req #HRREQ-1423 (Senior Serving Runtime Engineer) — critical for Q1 latency OKRs.
- Two Backend SDE ICs for Dedicated capacity (throughput work) — medium-critical, impacts capacity targets.
- Product Manager for Optimize — lower immediate impact; helps cost/perf tooling roadmap.
- Two CS backfills (Senior CSM and Implementation Lead) — high-risk for renewals with Acme and Nova if we delay.

Asks: 
1) Which items do we greenlight now vs defer to H1?
2) Any freeze-exception approvals needed (if so, list approvers).
3) Can TalentOps prepare expedited offer packs for the approved reqs?

Notes: I flagged the CS backfills as renewal risk in the rightmost column of the sheet — see row highlights. I propose we treat the infra engineer and at least one CS backfill as priority 1. If we need to trade off, we should consider deferring the Optimize PM.

Aisha Rahman
Director, Talent & Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2026-11-hiring-slate.xlsx

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring: knife-edge decision log

Thanks Aisha — solid consolidation. My quick take: prioritize the Serving Runtime Engineer (HRREQ-1423) and both CS backfills. The Dedicated SDEs are important but we can stage them into Q1 if we commit to a temporary contractor for throughput spikes.

If Finance can sign off on moving $150k from discretionary hiring into the infra bucket, I will greenlight the Sr Infra req. Jonas, can you confirm runway for that?

-Markus

Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring: knife-edge decision log

Agree with prioritizing HRREQ-1423 and one CS backfill. A quick data point: our Dedicated queue forecast (sheet tab "utilization") shows >80% utilization only for brief bursts in Dec; if we accept some burst routing + a contractor, we protect SLAs without committing two full-time SDEs right away.

Proposal: 
- Approve Senior Serving Runtime Engineer now.
- Approve 1 CS backfill now (Implementation Lead).
- Put the second Dedicated SDE and the Optimize PM into a deferred bucket for re-review in Jan (Jan 10 leadership sync).

If TalentOps can prep a single-off offer for the infra role with standard comp band and 2-week close target, we should be able to move quickly.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Procure Team <procure@acmeprocure.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring: knife-edge decision log

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 8:30 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Agree with prioritizing HRREQ-1423 and one CS backfill. 

Aisha — flagged a renewal-related escalation: Acme (Sarah Jones) made it explicit they expect a named implementation lead on their account during the onboarding window. If we miss that window we face a 30% slower time-to-value and potential churn at renewal. I recommend we treat the Implementation Lead backfill as priority 1 for retention reasons.

Operational asks: 
- Finance: please confirm a one-time reallocation to cover the backfill and the infra role; we can absorb from Q4 discretionary. Markus, appreciate your note — can you commit to the $150k movement?
- Procurement: looped Procure Team to speed any contractor conversion/NDAs if we need stopgap support.
- TalentOps: please get candidate pack ready and confirm ability to present offers within 7 business days.

If we get alignment by Friday EOD (11/20) I'll authorize immediate outreach to the top two CS candidates. Otherwise we risk missing the Dec onboarding window.

Monica Patel
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, TalentOps <offers@talentops.io>, Procure Team <procure@acmeprocure.com>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Leadership hiring: knife-edge decision log

Thank you all — summary & decision log below. I am marking this as the official "knife-edge" call so TalentOps can act. Final decisions (per consensus):

DECISIONS (approved now):
- HRREQ-1423 Senior Serving Runtime Engineer — APPROVED (Markus confirmed $150k reallocation).
- Implementation Lead (CS backfill) — APPROVED (Monica authorized outreach to top two candidates).

DEFERRED: 
- Dedicated SDE #1 and #2 — put on deferred list to re-evaluate Jan 10 leadership sync.
- Optimize Product Manager — deferred to H1 2027 planning.

ACTIONS: 
- TalentOps (offers@talentops.io): please prepare expedited offer for HRREQ-1423 and the Implementation Lead. Target: send offers within 7 business days. Attach decision log (knife-edge-decision-log.pdf) to candidate packets.
- Procurement (procure@acmeprocure.com): stand by for any contractor NDAs; if we need temporary coverage, expedite conversion paths.
- Finance (Markus): please confirm transaction for $150k reallocation to capacity by EOD 11/21.

If any of you need a formal sign-off artifact for QBR decks, I uploaded the decision log + annotated slate to the Drive: https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1HiringSlate2026 (see tab "Decisions").

Quoted for traceability:
> On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 2:45 PM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Aisha — flagged a renewal-related escalation: Acme (Sarah Jones) made it explicit they expect a named implementation lead on their account during the onboarding window.
> > If we miss that window we face a 30% slower time-to-value and potential churn at renewal.

I'll close this thread once offers are out and finance confirms the allocation. Thanks for the rapid alignment.

Aisha Rahman
Director, Talent & Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference
Attachments: knife-edge-decision-log.pdf
